about_the_game:
It's been a decade since a pandemic swept through the world. Billions were infected by a bacteriophage that first killed them, then brought them back under its control, turning them into violent monsters... Entirely conscious of their actions until someone finally puts them out of their misery. You are that someone, part of an elite search and rescue unit responsible for evacuating human survivors from infected areas.

This is Infect Cam: High stakes, adrenaline-fueled co-op survival, where you and your team of four are always outnumbered and facing impossible odds, fighting against an endless horde, managing scarce resources, and keeping each other safe in a deployment that might change the fortunes of humanity...

Four Player Tactical Co-Op

Each rescue team has four members. Alone, none will survive and only together do you have a chance. Communicate with each other and work closely to avoid being overwhelmed, share resources, and plan for each encounter to make sure you have a fighting chance.

Survive The Impossible

Every moment counts - and so does every bullet, medkit, and teammate. Experience the struggle for survival from the level of a body cam, dealing with limited visibility, scrounging for supplies, and constantly staying on your toes, making decisions that can save or doom your rescue team.

Search & Rescue

Every mission is a distinct experience, spread across multiple maps, each more challenging than the last. The closer you get to your objective, the more dangerous the zombies and the fewer the resources. Change and adapt your strategies and teamwork to find survivors, save them - and maybe find something to help find a cure for the plague...

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11500 veya AMD Ryzen 5 4500
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super veya AMD Radeon RX 590 (8 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K veya AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 veya AMD Radeon RX 6800
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space

short_description: Suit up and get ready to rescue survivors of a zombie plague! Team up with friends and form an elite search & rescue unit deploying into an area overrun by zombies. Find survivors and survive against relentless hordes in a co-op zombie survival game experienced through the sturdy lens of a body cam.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Russian, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
